newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: KPN buys 9.9 pct of TNT on-market.
newsitem.headline: KPN buys 9.9 pct of TNT on-market.

text.p: Dutch telecom and postal group Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV (KPN) said on Wednesday it had acquired 9.9 percent of TNT Ltd on-market after earlier announcing a A$2.0 billion agreed takeover offer for the Australian transport group.

In a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX), KPN said it had bought 57.96 million TNT ordinary shares at prices up to A$2.45 per share and 20.79 million TNT converting preference shares at prices up to A$2.51 per share representing 9.9 percent of TNT's total issued capital.
Earlier KPN launched a A$2.45 per share cash takeover bid for TNT, 50 percent above TNT's share price close on Tuesday.

TNT ordinary shares closed 79 cents higher at A$2.42 on turnover of 74.26 million shares. The company's converting preference shares closed 68 cents higher at A$2.46 on turnover of 24.60 million shares.
